theme_archetype.archetype: Hybrid: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) + Archetype 7 (Electric / Code Terminal)
theme_archetype.description: A striking, highly secure, dark aesthetic. Avoids generic SaaS violet-on-white. Uses deep void black with subtle indigo/violet glowing mesh and obsidian textures. Emphasizes technical depth, luxury, and premium learning experience.

rules.gradients: Do not use full-screen flat color gradients. Use texture + radial glow. Highlight active states with the #6A66EB Ko-fi color.
rules.backgrounds: Keep the main background near #050508. Use #0A0A0F for cards.
rules.text: Never use pure white #FFFFFF for body text. Use #EDEDED (95% lightness) for readability.
rules.transparency: Do not use completely transparent backgrounds for surfaces that overlap content (e.g., sticky headers). Always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent color.

rules.anti_default: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk. Headings MUST be Bricolage Grotesque. Body MUST be JetBrains Mono.
rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Large headings can use subtle text-shadow for depth.
rules.labels: Use small, widely tracked uppercase JetBrains Mono for tags, ranks (#1-70), and category names.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. The roadmap must feel like a learning journey/atlas, not a spreadsheet.
spacing_and_layout.roadmap_grid: Use Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetric card placements. Instead of standard columns, use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 with varying col-span values (e.g., col-span-4, col-span-6, col-span-8) to create an organic, branching skill-tree look.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Use Mode B: The 'Control Room' Grid for the Admin Dashboard. Dense, border-collapse styles. 1px borders everywhere.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Containers with borders must use p-6 or p-8. Use py-24 for marketing sections.
spacing_and_layout.mobile: Always ensure max-w-full and overflow-x-hidden to prevent horizontal scrolling. Stack gracefully.

cards.style: The 'Tracing Beam' / Technical Look. 1px border of border-indigo, bg-obsidian. No soft shadows, use drop-shadow with the primary color for glow on hover.
cards.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color becomes brighter #6A66EB, subtle glow.

buttons.primary: bg-[#6A66EB] text-white hover:bg-[#5853D6] rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-body uppercase tracking-wider text-sm font-bold

navigation.header: Sticky glassmorphism header. bg-void-black/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#6A66EB]/20 z-50.

pdf_viewer.watermark: CRITICAL: Absolute positioned, pointer-events-none, z-[9999], repeated text of the user's email diagonally across the screen with opacity 0.1 to prevent screenshots.
pdf_viewer.tabs: Shadcn Tabs component customized with JetBrains Mono, flat rectangular triggers.

badges.published: bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 font-code text-xs rounded-full
badges.locked: bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 font-code text-xs rounded-full

kofi_widget.style: Floating at bottom-right, fixed, z-50. Button uses #6A66EB, pill shape, bounce animation.

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have transition-all duration-200. Focus states require focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#6A66EB].
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Use framer-motion for staggering the roadmap language cards. It should feel like loading a terminal sequence or unlocking a map.

logo.description:
PolyCode School Logo. Stylized P with

brackets. Use in header and auth gate.

hero_background.description: Deep violet and indigo glowing mesh abstract background. Use this for the Auth Gate background and the top hero section of the Roadmap with an overlay of bg-black/60.

texture_obsidian.description: Abstract dark obsidian texture. Use as a subtle background pattern for the Course Detail Page or Admin Dashboard, opacity 10%.

kofi_iframe.instructions: Embed the Ko-fi widget using standard iframe with URL parameter for the PolyCode account (mocked if not provided). Keep the brand color #6A66EB.

auth_page.layout: Full screen, centered bento-box card. Hero background image behind with heavy blur.
auth_page.features: Email/Password inputs + Google Sign-In button. JetBrains mono for inputs.

roadmap_landing.hero: Massive H1 in Bricolage Grotesque. Subtle pulsing glow behind the text.
roadmap_landing.categories: 6 categories (Fondamentaux, Intermédiaire, Avancé, Spécialisé, Niche/Académique, Historique/Rare).
roadmap_landing.cards: Language cards #1 to #70. Show rank prominently. Badge for Publié/Verrouillé. Asymmetric layout using different column spans.

course_detail.layout: Clean sidebar for chapters, main content area for details. Locked chapters grayed out (opacity-50) with a lock icon.

pdf_viewer_page.security: Disable right click via JS. Absolute positioned watermark over the iframe/canvas. The watermark must contain the user's email. No download button.

admin_dashboard.layout: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look). Table for courses with toggle switches (Shadcn switch) for publish/unpublish.
admin_dashboard.modal: Create Chapter dialog with Shadcn UI. Fields for Name, Google Drive link Cours, Google Drive link Correction.

messaging.layout: Terminal-style chat interface. 1-to-1 user and admin. Monospaced timestamps.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Bricolage Grotesque and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Implement the Firebase Auth gate at the root level so the site cannot be accessed without login.
All labels and text MUST be in French.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the asymmetric Roadmap grid to allow flexible spans.
Use Shadcn UI for the Auth forms, Tabs (PDF Viewer), Dialog (Admin Modal), Switch, and Dropdown Menus.
